precepts.text: Blessed is he whosoever shall not be offended in Christ, that is, not offended with every word in this Bible, since the Bible represents Christ.
precepts.point: Lord, I have hoped for Thy salvation, and done Thy commandments. My soul hath kept Thy testimonies, and I love them exceedingly. I have kept Thy precepts and Thy testimonies, for all my ways are before Thee.

note.label: Psalm 119: Blessed Are the Undefiled in the Way

precepts.why:
“And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.” David says “Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.” Not being offended in Christ means not being offended with every word in this Bible, since the Bible represents Christ.

Princes persecuted David without a cause, yet his heart stood in awe of the word; he rejoiced at the word as one that findeth great spoil, and he hated and abhorred lying, all the falsehood and backbiting against us, while loving the law. Sometimes we do get offended, but that is part of our pilgrimage.
